stage2_dives.note: Gemini-dependency rationale false at pinned commit 115de305. Empirically confirmed on llama.cpp v9: OAI logprob shape, no top_logprobs cap (20/40/64), pre-sampler head (temp 0 == temp 1 byte-identical), 19/20 A-T letters in head. Two new findings: thinking models put <think> at position 0 so the head contains zero score letters and fails SILENTLY; and verifier COMPETENCE is the real blocker (n=8 smoke test, 7/8 correct-over-buggy, bimodal gaps, one confident inversion).
